title: Relay-Spark Seeker
text: Relay-Spark Seeker flits between dead receivers and steals the first clean pulse it can find. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: It mistakes communication for loose fuel.

defeatReward.text: Relay-Spark Seeker is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
